listings.title: Old Fashioned Farm Estate Sale
listings.description: * Sale Postponed to Next Weekend 10/3 - 10/4 Due to Weather - See You Then! 🤠* We are always hunting for old farms frozen in time... this is one of those special treasure hunts! *UPDATE 9/24 - Native American artifacts were uncovered hidden deep in a closet! These were found decades ago on the grounds of the farm, within the cow fields. More photos of the Ware chairs, record collection, and Ford 8n Tractor. *UPDATE 9/23 - MORE PHOTOS ADDED* This century old dairy farm has fresh, multigenerational, and regionally made treasure to uncover including primitives, tools, decoration, furniture, and more dating back to the 1800's. Ford Gas 1948 8N Tractor with Loader - Starts Up & Runs Perfect Hit & Miss Engine, Vintage Gas Pumps, Primitive Shaker Style Ware Chairs , Early American Pine Primitive Corner Cabinet Primitive decor, Good Tools, Heavy Farm Bolts & Hardware, Gas Pumps, Antique Books, Retro Glassware, Mahogany Corner Cabinet, Early Arm & Hammer Anvil, Tons of Tins, Primitive Ice Harvesting Tools, Antique Wooden Boxes, Farm Bolts & Goods, Cattle Panels, 70's GMC Farm Truck Parts, ...and much more as we uncover this estate! The Ware chairs & corner cabinet have been on the property and a piece of Gloucester County history for 150 years! A brief history of the Ware Chairs: Ware chairs were made between 1800 and 1940 by five generations of a family in the Cumberland County community of Roadstown, northwest of Bridgeton. The patriarch, Maskell Ware, found a niche in the furniture market by turning out rocking chairs. Subsequent Ware chairs were characterized by slat backs, woven-rush seats and uprights, and stretchers turned on a lathe. More photos & details on the tractor to come. We update our listings usually daily before sales, check back regularly. Add us on Facebook to get all of the information first: Facebook.com/AuctionsByMesiano

listings.title: Noteworthy Newtown Square! A Two Part Estate Sale!
listings.description: Noteworthy Newtown Square! A Two-Part Estate Sale Packed With Vintage, Unusual & Unexpected Finds! Part 1 — Friday, Saturday & Sunday October 16th – 18th 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Daily Part 2 — Saturday, October 24th 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Before You Visit... Noteworthy Newtown Square Is Packed — And So Is The House! Because Of The Extraordinary Amount Of Merchandise And Limited Space Throughout The Home, We Will Be Allowing Approximately 15 Shoppers Inside At One Time. For Your Convenience, We Will Also Be Offering A Limited Number Of Optional Shopping Appointments Throughout The Sale. Walk-In Shoppers Are Always Welcome — Appointments Are Never Required. If We Are At Capacity When You Arrive, We Simply Ask For Your Patience Until Space Becomes Available. Get Ready For A Truly Noteworthy Estate Sale! We're Just Beginning To Unpack And Sort Boxes Stacked Throughout The Home, And Already We're Finding An Incredible Variety — From Loads Of Jewelry And Decorative Treasures To Furniture, Outdoor Items, Collectibles, Household Finds And So Much More. With This Much Merchandise, One Weekend Simply Isn't Enough! We'll Be Replenishing And Adding Fresh Merchandise Throughout The Entire Sale. As Items Sell And Space Opens Up, More Will Be Brought Out — So What You See On Friday May Be Very Different From What You Find On Saturday Or Sunday. And We'll Continue Unpacking And Preparing Even More Merchandise For Part 2! Here's Just A Glimpse Of What We're Uncovering: Loads Of Jewelry Vintage Decorative Pieces & Accessories Furniture Artwork & Wall Décor Collectibles & Unusual Finds China, Crystal & Glassware Kitchen & Entertaining Pieces Outdoor Furnishings & Accessories Household Items Vintage Treasures And So Much More! We're Just Getting Started! Our Photo Gallery Will Continue To Grow As We Unpack, So Be Sure To Check Back For New Photos And Updates. Noteworthy Newtown Square — Two Parts. Tons To Discover. And Definitely Nothing Ordinary!
